text.p: Tropical Storm Abel is weakening and will probably be downgraded to a depression just south of Guangdong China this period. Moisture from the storm will track through Guangdong producing heavy rain and possible flooding.
Tropical Depression 31W will intensify to a tropical storm while moving through the Mariana Islands producing gusty winds and locally heavy rain squalls.
Tropical Depression 32W is expected to move westward across Luzon, Philippines within 48 hours as a strong tropical storm. Flooding may result. Wind damage is also possible.
